correctness.rationale: A coordinate order α has a unique affine-normalized representative α_0=0,α_1=1; distinct normalized orders are distinct dimension-two codes. For equal-length words d_insdel=2(q-LCS), and the maximum LCS among distinct affine permutations α and uα+v gives τ=q-1-L_max (constant codewords have LCS<=1). The reduction of LCS between permutations to strict LIS of position indices is exact. An independently written finite-field/LIS C++ exhaustive enumeration reproduced the eight τ histograms for all (q-2)! normalized orders, notably 362880 q=11 codes times 109 nonidentity transforms. An independent q=13 LCS dynamic-programming check reproduced histogram 3:6,4:37,5:73,6:39 and τ=6; the Hamming radius is 5. No q=13 full census or larger-q claim follows.
